s: Perush birkat repaenu vedinah ubo seip echad: "repaenu Hashem venerape hoshienu ku'" hu leshon hakkatub "repaeni Hashem veerape hoshieni veivvashea ki tehillati atta", lepikak en lomar "repaenu Hashem eloqenu" ella bilshon hakkatub. Veap al pi shehakkatub layyachid en mekannin oto larabbim vekan omerim bilshon rabbim mah shekkatub bilshon yachid — yesh omerim shehattaam hu mippene shello aseru ella bizman shemmitkavven liqrot o letargem, sheeno rashshay leshannot milleshon hakkatub, abal kesheomer derek tepilla ubaqqasha — muttar leshannot happasuq lepi tzorek hashshaa ulepi inyan hattechinna ubaqqasha. Veyesh omerim shehattaam hu mippene shello aseru leshannot ella kesheqqore kol hammizmor o kol hainyan kasseder, veaz apillu derek tepilla ubaqqasha asur leshannot, abal keshemmitpallel veomer pesuqim henna vahenna — yakol leshannot miyyachid lerabbim umerabbim leyachid. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem shello leshannot mizmor shalem miyyachid lerabbim o lehepek apillu derek tepilla, vegam pasuq lo yeshanneh ella kesheomero derek tepilla ubaqqasha kemo shennitbaer lassebara harishona (lepi sheepshar sheggam lassebara haacharona lo hittiru ella bederek zeh):
